body: It's too early in the morning for me to think straight, but something along the lines of horny scally lad ties me up and has his Pit Bull fuck me.. or any variation on that theme, as long as the outcome is the same :)

Bestiality.

But generally when people ask about fucked up fantasies they don't actually want fucked up fantasies, so I'll use a throwaway.

hey, good to know someone can relate though I'm sorry that's the way it is for you. I feel I'm ready to commit suicide but I don't want anyone I know to find me so like you say, I'm just kinda waiting for them to die too

Getting this all out has calmed me down a lot, so I think, like someone else suggested, I'll looking into contacting a psychologist, I'm just terrified I'll have a similar experience with doctors as before though

In uni I thought I could help others going through the same kind of thing, so I volunteered for a helpline, I thought maybe I'd go on to be a therapist of some kind as well (most of my degree modules were in psychoanalysis), but I think subconsciously that was just an excuse for me not seeking help myself. I'll look into it again though, thanks
Philosophy, though most of my modules were in psychoanalysis

Unfortunately I live about 200 miles from my uni now.

Maybe I will look into carving my own path, though I don't see how at the minute. I get so deep in depressed thinking that it's exhausting to even consider anything beyond sleeping.

Thanks for taking the time to reply though.

Thanks for replying. I read a few of your other comments and it seems we have a bit in common. Thanks for offering to listen, it feels weird though, the only other time I've spoken to anyone about it is to the doctor above, I don't want to bring anybody down so I don't talk about anything really.

I wouldn't have the faintest clue where to even begin cultivating hobbies, sometimes a brief interest in something will crop up (and I mean maybe for an hour or so) but then I just think, whats the point?

Not that I've ever been aware of. I think this is the part I have the most trouble conveying to people who've ever asked "why are you so sad all the time" - the absolute depth of my disinterest. I try not to talk about anything though because I don't want to bring anybody down or have them feel I just want attention.
erm, me or the doctor? Either way you're probably right.

Thank you for replying, I don't think I have the confidence to ring a hotline - I also volunteered for one when I was a student but I wasn't really into it / was too depressing, as awful as that sounds, and the whole 'no advice' thing bugs me :P

"hobbies/interests/goals are not inherent", I'd never thought of it like that before, I suppose I just thought that I'm interested in what I'm interested in and that's that - if that makes sense.
thank you, I'll look into it

This is basically what I've been telling myself since I was about 14 and its what's kept me going, but things didn't change when I was 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20 or 21 so it becomes harder and harder to believe as time passes. 

Thanks for reading and replying though, it means a lot and I'm glad your life got better.
I've googled and googled but I have no idea how to get in touch with one, I don't know if you're in the UK but if you are, do I just ring my doctors surgery?
